notes.title: Crazy Zen Mini Golf Demo: Broadcast
notes.content:
[i]"Crazy Zen Mini Golf" offers an immersive and thrilling mini-golf experience set in a magical and zen-like garden. The game aims to provide players with a mesmerizing adventure as they navigate through various challenging holes.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41523810/13bd4522da4e26aac0b206fa413f24188a1ecde2.jpg[/img]

Are you ready to immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Crazy Zen Mini Golf? Prepare for an extraordinary adventure as we take you on a thrilling journey through our zany zen garden. Mark your calendars and get ready to witness the most mesmerizing mini-golf game ever created!

[h1]What to Expect:[/h1]
✅[b] Experience the Mind-Blowing Gameplay:[/b] Be captivated by the sensational gameplay of Crazy Zen Mini Golf as you navigate through crazy courses filled with awesome obstacles.
✅ [b]Stunning Scenery:[/b] Prepare to be amazed by the breathtakingly beautiful backdrops that set the stage for your exhilarating adventure.
✅ [b]Multiplayer Madness:[/b] Compete against friends or join forces to conquer the courses together in the local multiplayer mode. Will you be the one to claim the top score?
✅ [b]Masterful Trick Shots:[/b] Witness incredible trick shots as our skilled players demonstrate their ability to control the ball while in motion, avoiding even the most challenging obstacles.
✅ [b]Developer Insights:[/b] Get exclusive behind-the-scenes live gameplay footage from the developers themselves, as they share their current playthrough footage for Crazy Zen Mini Golf.

[h1]ABOUT[/h1]

The game features stunning and breathtaking backdrops that create an enchanting atmosphere for players to enjoy. Each course is designed with crazy obstacles and challenges, such as swinging pendulums, moving platforms, and even Dragon's mouths. Players must demonstrate their skills by carefully selecting their swing strength, aiming accurately, and shooting the ball to reach the hole in as few strokes as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41523810/eaeea2a58e8dcf20bb52d258d31e88343fc9d77a.jpg[/img]

To enhance gameplay, players can collect coins that provide additional advantages and boost their chances of outperforming their opponents. The game also offers a local multiplayer mode, allowing friends to compete against each other and strive for the top score.

One unique feature of the game is the ability to control the ball even while it's in motion, enabling players to execute impressive trick shots and navigate through difficult obstacles with precision. Additionally, teleportation and cannons are available to help players strategically move across the courses, while boost pads provide extra momentum to propel the ball forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41523810/da28e8ec8f6e93577910760a7535210356f7feb3.jpg[/img]

If you're seeking a mini-golf game that combines stunning visuals, challenging courses, and exciting gameplay mechanics, "Crazy Zen Mini Golf" offers all of that and the opportunity to become a putting pro.

[h1]Features[/h1]
■Crazy courses
■Awesome obstacles
■Stunning scenery
■Varied 9 hole courses
■Local Multiplayer
■Teleportation
■Cannons
■Boost pads
